chapters.title: Chapter 1299 - Immortal Burying Coffin
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!
The ice coffin was made out of ten-thousand-year-old ice. One could feel its extreme coldness and heaviness just by looking at it.
Its top was enshrouded with icy mist and the inside couldn’t be seen clearly.

Many of them attempted to use their divine sense to see what was inside the ice coffin, but they were blocked by some ancient seal. This had made them even more suspicious of the thing that was hidden inside the coffin. Someone guessed that it might be the creator of the tomb.

When Jiang Chen saw the ice coffin, he felt even more uneasy. He didn’t like this kind of inexplicable feeling, but the feeling was real. He used the Great Soul Derivation Technique to check what was inside the coffin, but the result was the same as the others.
“Inside the coffin has to be the creator of the ancient tomb. How long did this coffin really existed?”
“Let’s go over to the altar and take a look. I think treasures must be hidden inside.”
“That’s right. Let’s go. Since we have come all the way here, we can’t return empty handed. We’ve got to get something no matter what.”

Many people couldn’t wait to move forward, especially Bu Qingfeng and the other three geniuses. They were the strongest here, so the cold Qi had the least impact on them. Plus, their desire to obtain the treasure inside the ice coffin was beyond everyone else.
Tuo Hai leaped onto the altar. Seeing that he was safe, everyone followed suit. As the altar was large, it wouldn’t be a problem even if all of them stood on it.

Just a moment passed and all the cultivators were already on top of the altar, but due to the coldness of the Qi reaching a terrifying degree, the late Heaven Immortals could no longer withstand it even with the help of the Divine Immortal experts. In fact, even the ordinary early Divine Immortal experts were having difficulty resisting the coldness, giving them no time to care for their juniors.
“No way. The cold Qi here is too strong. We can’t bear it.”
Someone shook his head helplessly and leaped off the altar.

Now that they were on the altar they began to observe the ice coffin once more at a closer distance. At the front of the coffin, under the mist, they could vaguely see some talisman marks, but the noble and ancient Qi exuded from it made them not dare to look at it directly.

At the center of the innumerable talisman marks was a larger ancient word. It flickered a few times before the experts could catch what that word was. The word was ‘BURIAL’. It was old, ancient and honorable. It radiated a Qi that stimulated people’s soul. If a person’s gaze didn’t move away from it, he would likely to be sucked away by the ice coffin.
“Immortal Burying Coffin. My God! This is Immortal Burying Coffin!”

All of a sudden, Bu Qingfeng exclaimed. He felt so excited that his body was trembling. It was a shock which he couldn’t feign, like he had just seen the most unbelievable thing in the Heavens and Earth.

As the words came out of Bu Qingfeng’s mouth, it caused a commotion in the crowd. Everyone’s expression changed, they seemed as shocked as Bu Qingfeng. Tuo Hai and the other two were no exception. Perhaps, they had never seen an Immortal Burying Coffin before, but all of them knew about the legend of this name.

“It’s really the Immortal Burying Coffin. According to legends, the Immortal Burying Coffin was made by Great Sovereign Emperor Zang Xian, a supreme figure that could move across the entire Immortal World unhindered and was on par with the Immortal Execution King. In the legends, the Immortal Burying Coffin was a peerless weapon that had buried countless of experts. It was said that the formidable Immortal Sovereign died in his Immortal Burying Coffin,” someone explained.
When he recalled the legends of the Immortal Burying Coffin, he couldn’t help mentioning Great Sovereign Zang Xian who was also known as the supreme Immortal Sovereign, an ancient existence.

“Why would the Immortal Burying Coffin emerge in a small place like One-Line-Sky? What kind of secret existed in this ancient tomb? Could it be that the one who is lying in the ice coffin is the Great Sovereign Zang Xian?”

Another person guessed, which immediately gave everyone the creeps. Even Bu Qingfeng and the other geniuses couldn’t help retreating several steps. Their faces paled. Zang Xian was a formidable and majestic Immortal Sovereign. Even if the body lying before them was merely a corpse, it would still scare them to death. Not just them, even the mighty Immortal Kings or Immortal Emperors or Immortal Venerables wouldn’t dare to approach the Immortal Burying Coffin.

“Not possible. Great Sovereign Zang Xian is an existence that couldn’t die. Who else in the entire Immortal World can kill him? however, there’s no explanation as to why the Immortal Burying Coffin was here.”
Somebody shook his head, but his fear for the coffin didn’t reduce in the slightest bit. The influence of Great Sovereign Zang Xian was so great that it could shock the whole Immortal World.

The emergence of the Immortal Burying Coffin was enough for everyone in the world. Despite having the powerful Sovereign’s Weapon in front of them, none of them dared to have any greedy thoughts. Even if this Natal Weapon of an Immortal Sovereign was given to them as present, they wouldn’t dare accept it as this wasn’t any kind of joke.

Great Sovereign Zang Xian... Immortal Execution King... these two unparalleled figures were drifting in Jiang Chen’s head. Their names alone showed how powerful they were. They were supreme existences in the Immortal World. However, something related to them were discovered in an insignificant tomb in One-Line-Sky. First was the Immortal Execution Broken Sword, and now was the Immortal Burying Coffin. This showed how extraordinary the secrets in this ancient tomb were.

Human Immortal, Earth Immortal, Heaven Immortal, Divine Immortal, Great Luo Golden Immortal, Immortal King, Immortal Emperor, Immortal Venerable and Immortal Sovereign. Of all the nine great realms, Immortal Sovereign realm was the highest and the formidable Great Sovereign Zang Xian and Great Sovereign Immortal Execution were the pinnacle existences amongst the Immortal Sovereigns. Anyone would tremble in fear just by hearing their names. Anything that was related to them could shake not only the Ethereal Immortal Domain, but the whole Immortal World.
“What’s actually hiding inside this ice coffin?”
Jiang Chen frowned. Instinctively, he believed that there must be some secret existing in this ice coffin.

Countless of them stood rooted to the ground. No one dared to move a step forward. The deterrent force of the Immortal Burying Coffin was no joke to anyone. This piece of coffin was the greatest treasure in the ancient tomb, but no one was qualified to wield it. Even Tian Muyun wouldn’t dare to possess it. Who else would dare to touch the item of Great Emperor Zang Xian?

No one believed that the Great Sovereign Zang Xian was already dead as they all knew that a Great Sovereign was a being that wouldn’t die, an existence that was incredibly near to God Dao, a level that they couldn’t even reach in their dream.
Just as everyone was in a dilemma, a sudden change occurred in the ice coffin. The mist and cold Qi on top of the coffin was fading away by itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1300 - Immortal Execution Order
paragraphs: 7th of the week!
“Look, the mist’s gone. The inside of the coffin is getting clearer.”

Someone shouted, but with controlled volume. Everyone was tensed once more while the mist continued to reduce. No one had a clue what was going to happen next. All their desire to obtain the treasure had already faltered and reduced, only wanting to see what the secret of the coffin really was.

Any kind of desire was just an extravagant thought before the Immortal Burying Coffin. Even if the Great Sovereign Zang Xian had really fallen, this piece of Sovereign Weapon couldn’t simply be possessed by anyone. Every Great Sovereign Weapon had its own spirit. It was they who chose their master and not the other way round.

Jiang Chen’s expression suddenly became extremely tensed. He had always been tough, and seldom experienced enormous fluctuations in his emotions, but as soon as all the mist was gone, some kind of strong emotion was stirring inside of him. Such emotion was unexplainable, but he was sure that this was connected to the secret inside the coffin.

Everyone was staring at it unblinkingly. All the mist had finally disappeared, revealing only the ice coffin. The word ‘BURIAL’ became even clearer now. Neither of them dared to look at it for too long, fearing that they wouldn’t be able to take it.
Subsequently, they saw a female corpse lying inside the ice coffin.

The corpse seemed incomparably serene. She was clad in white clothes. Even though her eyes were closed, it still couldn’t hide her peerless beauty. Any beautiful thing or being that was used to describe her appearance would only degrade her real beauty, because nothing could match her beauty.

There was a unique chilling disposition on her body, as if she had fully integrated with the entire ice palace. On top of her body was a layer of frost. Any person with keen eyes would be able to see that the layer of frost was the ten-thousand-year-old Ice Marrow, which was also the material that Great Sovereign Zang Xian had used to build the coffin. It was a precious and rare material.
“She’s beautiful.”
“So beautiful...”
“How could there be such a pretty lady in the Heavens and Earth? Even though it’s a corpse that has existed for unknown number of years, she’s just as pretty as the snow lotus on the ice mountain.”
Innumerable experts exclaimed in surprise. Not just males, even females who came here were subdued by the corpse’s unparalleled beauty.

No one knew the origin of the female corpse or why she was lying in the Immortal Burying Coffin, but there was one thing they were sure of—this female corpse surely wasn’t Great Sovereign Zang Xian, everyone knew that the Great Sovereign was a man, a truly domineering man.
Currently, Jiang Chen was completely stunned. He gaped at the corpse and was at a loss of words, because her appearance was too familiar. Someone he couldn’t never think of even in his dream.
“Xiao Yu, no, what exactly has happened?”

Jiang Chen was losing control over his emotions. The female corpse inside the coffin wasn’t someone else, it was Yan Chenyu. No matter how composed Jiang Chen was, his mind would be thrown into chaos under such circumstance. Why would Yan Chenyu emerge in the Immortal Burying Coffin in the Immortal World? What kind of secret was involved in this?

“Could it be she isn’t Xiao Yu and only has the same looks as her? But the Qi exuded from her is just like Xiao Yu’s. Besides, why did I feel so uneasy before this? I didn’t have any relation to Great Sovereign Zang Xian. That uneasiness must’ve come from Xiao Yu. Could it be that she is already dead?”
Jiang Chen’s emotions fluctuated greatly. Despite his smartness, he felt helpless. He didn’t know how to deal with this situation.

Yan Chenyu had the Nine Yin Meridians and was an inheritor of Ice God. The Qi radiating from the coffin was the same as Yan Chenyu’s. Therefore, Jiang Chen couldn’t help linking the two of them together. If something were to happen to Yan Chenyu, he wouldn’t be able to take it.
“Look, everyone, there’s an order token on the ice coffin.”

Suddenly, someone spoke and pointed to the golden order token on the ice coffin. It was lackluster and gave people the feeling of dullness. Some experts vaguely saw the two words engraved on the order token - Immortal Execution.
“That’s the Immortal Execution Order! My Goodness! There is actually such a huge secret in this miniature ancient tomb. This must be related to the two peerless Great Sovereigns.”

“This is really the Immortal Execution Order. In the whole Immortal world, no one would dare to use such token. It is said that the person who obtains the Immortal Execution Order can ask a favor from the Immortal Execution King. Motherf*cker! This is the treasure of the world! There’s no way of getting this Immortal Burying Coffin anymore, but with this Immortal Execution Order, I’m going to be super rich!”
“It’s a pledge made by the Immortal Execution King. That’s something that can’t be replaced even with countless of treasures.”
No one could stay calm. Their expression was beyond astonishment. This quiet piece of token would surely shake the entire Immortal World.
“Haha! The Immortal Execution Order is mine!”
In the face of such temptation, a Divine Immortal rogue cultivator raced forward like a crazy man. Plenty of people would lose their minds in front of such a rare and priceless token.
“Argh...”

Something unusual occurred. The Immortal Execution Order wasn’t something that was easy to get. Before the rogue cultivator could even get close to the ice coffin, he let out a wail and his body exploded. The blood and internal organs that fell out from the body were instantly frozen before dropping onto the floor along with the body like a statue.
*Hiss...*
Everybody sucked in a breath of cold air. Those who were about to make a move froze in their tracks. The scene was too horrifying. The cultivator died so quickly and without warning.
“That’s the invisible power radiating from the Immortal Burying Coffin. It seems like the ice coffin is related to the female corpse.”
“Do not act recklessly. It’s too dangerous. The Immortal Execution Order isn’t something that can easily be obtained. You may die if you get near to it.”

“However, go ahead if you want to try, perhaps the Immortal Execution Order will also choose its own master. If someone has enough luck to get the acknowledgement of the token, that person will prosper.”

The atmosphere became restless all of a sudden. The emergence of the Immortal Execution Order had affected the hearts of all the people here. But due to the failure of the first person, no one dared to make a move now. That was horrifying. A single mistake could cost them their lives. Even if the Immortal Execution Order was probably finding its master or the female corpse inside the coffin was controlling all of these, no one dared to test their luck, because death was irreversible.

Even Bu Qingfeng and the other geniuses didn’t dare make half a step forward. Although they were Golden Immortal experts, standing before the Immortal Burying Coffin, they were no different than Divine Immortal experts. They wouldn’t dare to joke around with their lives. They were now just waiting to reap the profits if the chance presented.
